title: Estimating a Rational Inattention Discrete Choice Model: A Semiparametric Approach
abstract: arXiv:2611.18479v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: People's choices depend on both the payoffs of the available options and what they learn about those payoffs before deciding. This paper shows how choice data identify both unobserved payoff heterogeneity and the cost of information acquisition in a rational inattention discrete-choice model. I establish conditions for semiparametric point identification using exogenous payoff and information-cost shifters, without imposing parametric forms on the taste-shock distribution or on how the unit cost of information varies with observed characteristics. In the model with binary choice, I construct an unobserved choice threshold whose cumulative distribution function is the choice probability as a function of the payoff shifter. Moments of this threshold identify the payoff coefficients and the unit cost of information at each value of the information-cost shifter. translated_title: 估计理性忽视离散选择模型：一种半参数方法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.18479v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：人们的选择既取决于可用选项的收益，也取决于他们在决策之前对这些收益所获取的信息。本文展示了在理性忽视离散选择模型中，选择数据如何同时识别不可观测的收益异质性和信息获取成本。我利用外生的收益变动工具和信息成本变动工具，建立了半参数点识别的条件，而无需对偏好冲击分布的参数形式或信息单位成本如何随可观测特征变化施加参数化假设。在二元选择模型中，我构建了一个不可观测的选择阈值，其累积分布函数即为选择概率作为收益变动工具的函数。该阈值的矩条件可以识别收益系数，以及信息成本变动工具在每一取值处的信息单位成本。随后，通过反卷积论证识别出偏好冲击的分布。接着我……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出一种半参数识别与估计方法，利用外生收益和信息成本变动工具，在不假设偏好冲击分布及信息成本函数参数形式的情况下，从选择数据中同时识别理性忽视离散选择模型中的收益系数、信息获取成本和偏好冲击分布。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a semiparametric identification and estimation approach for rational inattention discrete choice models, using exogenous payoff and information-cost shifters to identify payoff coefficients, information acquisition costs, and the taste-shock distribution from choice data without imposing parametric assumptions.
